quote.text: Cuando veas una pequeña luz brillar, !síguela! Si te dirige al pantano, pues ya saldrás de él. Pero si no la sigues, toda tu vida vivirás arrepentido, porque nunca, nunca sabrás, si esa ... era TU estrella
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Just as Seneca urges us to follow even the tiniest light, in parenthood we must heed the subtle signs of our children's budding interests and talents, nurturing them even when the path may appear unclear.
    • The willingness to explore these faint signals can lead to unexpected growth—helping our children discover aspects of themselves they might otherwise never reveal, ultimately guiding them to their own "star."
  • Leadership:
    • A true leader recognizes that even small, seemingly insignificant ideas or opportunities can illuminate a new strategy or direction for the team, suggesting that the journey might be as valuable as the destination.
    • By following these lights with courage and discernment—even if the route initially appears fraught with challenges—a leader transforms uncertainty into a wellspring of innovation and collective progress.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, minor market signals or user feedback should be embraced as potential beacons that inspire innovation, just as that small light might reveal a better path forward.
    • Boldly investigating these insights, even at the risk of temporary setbacks, can lead to breakthroughs that distinguish your product and align it with true user needs—ensuring you never live with the regret of unexplored potential.
